extras: Do not enable this plugin together with the original Tab Limiter plugin.
intentEvidence: This project is based on the original Tab Limiter plugin and was modified in May 2026 to change the limit behavior from rejection to LRU replacement.
problem: Users may open too many Markdown tabs, leading to performance issues or cluttered workspaces.

relations.evidence: This project is based on the original Tab Limiter plugin and was modified in May 2026 to change the limit behavior from rejection to LRU replacement.

summary: LRU Tab Limiter is an Obsidian plugin that enforces a configurable maximum number of open Markdown tabs by closing the least recently used tab when the limit is exceeded.
